core_claim.P: createPair() in GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol computes the salt from four addresses while pairFor() in Launchpad.sol computes it from only two addresses
core_claim.I: the pair address predicted by pairFor() must equal the address of the pair actually created by createPair()
core_claim.V: the predicted pair address and the created pair address can never match

distinct_impacts.description: When a launchToken's totalFeeShare becomes zero, endRewards() in Launchpad.sol uses pairFor() to predict the pair address; because the prediction does not match the deployed pair, the function interacts with a non-existent contract and reverts
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the function will attempt to interact with a non-existent contract, leading to a revert

distinct_impacts.description: endRewards functionality cannot be executed correctly
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: This failure prevents the endRewards functionality from being executed correctly.

distinct_impacts.description: Salt value mismatch: createPair() uses four addresses to calculate the salt while pairFor() uses only two
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: The createPair() function in GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory.sol uses four addresses to calculate the salt value, whereas the pairFor() function in Launchpad.sol uses only two addresses for the same calculation.
